generation_assumption.seam_rule: Place a generation boundary only on a hard cut that changes location, lighting and time (time skip). Open the new generation on an insert (phone, screen, light beam, hands, vehicle detail) before re-establishing the hero's face.

beats.note: Doubter acts on hero; stakes object in frame; hook line on screen

shot_vocabulary.HOOK_CONFRONT_MS: MS or OTS: doubter faces the hero with the stakes object raised. First frame.
shot_vocabulary.REACT_ECU: ECU eyes and mouth, static or push to lens, after every blow and payoff.
shot_vocabulary.DOUBTER_LEAN_ECU: Doubter leans into the lens and points. Peak of the ultimatum; mirrored at the reversal.
shot_vocabulary.STAKES_REVEAL_WS: Whip or rush WS revealing the scale of the problem.
shot_vocabulary.ISOLATION_WS_BEHIND: Hero small in frame, seen past foreground silhouettes.
shot_vocabulary.PROP_HOLD_MS: Hero stares at the symbolic prop, slow push, silence.
shot_vocabulary.EXILE_WS: Hero outside with belongings at dusk.
shot_vocabulary.TOPDOWN_COLLAPSE: Overhead: hero lying amid the mess, screen glow.
shot_vocabulary.GRIND_RELIGHT: Locked framing re-lit across day, night and golden hour to show time passing.
shot_vocabulary.SCREEN_FLIP: Monitor turns from red with a big negative to green with stacking positive lines and one final figure.
shot_vocabulary.UI_FLOAT_CARD: Clean card or bubble with one number floating beside the device.
shot_vocabulary.POV_PHONE: Hand holds a phone: incoming call, listing, camera.
shot_vocabulary.POV_INSIDE_OBJECT: Camera inside a box or drawer looking up at faces.
shot_vocabulary.PHONE_LIT_CU: Face up-lit by a screen while reading the result.
shot_vocabulary.SPLIT_FEED: Faces in the top half, phone feed in the bottom half.
shot_vocabulary.REVEAL_DETAIL: Key fob to lens, wheel, headlight, door opening.
shot_vocabulary.ARRIVAL_LOW_ANGLE: Hero steps out of a vehicle toward the lens.
shot_vocabulary.STATUS_WS_DAYLIGHT: Bright exterior with water or sky and celebrating people.
shot_vocabulary.TRACK_RUN: Lateral tracking as the hero runs out into the sun.
shot_vocabulary.FLASHBACK_BURST: 6-8 flicks under 0.15 s of the wound, ending in a white flash.
shot_vocabulary.CALLBACK_MIRROR: Same location and framing as the hook, with roles reversed.
shot_vocabulary.DIRECT_ADDRESS_CU: Hero turns to the lens and smirks while the CTA appears.
shot_vocabulary.END_CARD: Black card with 2 lines of white condensed caps.

lighting_by_beat.hook: warm interior practicals or bright fluorescents, soft key
lighting_by_beat.grind: cool blue low-key, monitor or phone glow, red/green chart spill
lighting_by_beat.payoff_ui: face up-lit by the screen, green glow
lighting_by_beat.wealth_reveal: bright sunlit exterior, golden hour, saturated, high key

writer_principles: Start inside the conflict: the first frame shows the doubter acting on the hero, with the stakes object visible.
Make the doubt personal: pick a doubter whose approval the hero needs or whose space he lives in.
Name the stakes with one number, place or label readable in under a second.
Give every blow a face: cut to the hero's reaction within about one second.
Escalate in concrete steps; each step takes something tangible.
Hold the low point still and quiet for one or two beats before anything speeds up.
Let the grind speak without words: hands, screens, changing light.
Land the turn on a screen: one big number or one short sentence, then the face reading it.
Reveal wealth from detail to whole, in daylight, ideally inside the doubter's world.
Close the loop: return to the opening place, prop or framing; the doubter reacts first, then the hero gives one short line answering the opening insult.
Keep lines to 2-6 words so each works as a caption.
End by handing the viewer a role: a binary judgement or a send-this-to-someone identity prompt.
Keep the hero's look simple and constant; change the world around him.
Show status through places, objects and crowd reactions; keep wardrobe everyday and tasteful.
Place generation seams on time skips so any drift reads as time passing.
locked_style: Stylized 3D animated feature-film look, vertical 9:16 frame. Characters have slightly enlarged heads, large glossy expressive eyes, arched expressive brows, soft rounded features, smooth subsurface-scattered skin, sculpted clumped hair and fabric with visible weave. Emotions are big and clear on the face. Cinematic physically based lighting with shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, gentle bloom on practical lights and subtle film grain. Warm golden interiors for everyday scenes; cool blue low-key with screen glow for night work; bright saturated daylight for success. Clean, unbranded props and wardrobe with no logos or readable brand names. Phone and monitor interfaces are clean, minimal and high-contrast with one large legible number. Smooth cinematic camera, no on-screen captions unless specified.
hero_default_look: slim young man in an oversized plain white tee, dark wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, thin silver chain

photo of the loss on screen

variety_rule: Each new story must differ from every reference and from the last 5 generated stories on at least 4 levers, and must never reuse a reference's exact doubter + stakes + reveal combination.
